{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent under-forecast bias that increases with longer horizons as true prices mean-revert from peaks",
    "When current price is at a 18-day high, model forecasts undershoot reality by 3-5 points compared to 1-2 points at lows",
    "Negative sentiment (value < 0) aligns model forecasts more closely with true outcomes, while positive sentiment extends the under-forecast gap",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative at day 10-15 forward looks ahead 2-3 days into the true outcome trajectory",
    "Model momentum (forecast direction matching history) over-responds to price changes, causing overshoot in opposite direction 2-3 days later",
    "When sentiment oscillates rapidly (within 24 hours), predictions at sentiment inflection points have 80%+ accuracy for the next 1-3 days",
    "Prices below 75.00 show stronger mean-reversion to model forecasts than prices above 80.00, where bias persists longer"
] }
